title: 장례식장에서: 상주에게 뭐라고 인사해요?
objective: You can greet a grieving coworker and comfort them with -더라도.
summary: Learn funeral hall phrases and how to comfort with -더라도.
setting: A funeral hall in the evening. Mark and his coworker Sujin have come because their team leader's father has died.

task.title: Comfort and choose words
task.line: Read the dialogue and word list first, then fill in, choose, or write each answer in Korean.

words.meaning: May the deceased rest in peace (the standard condolence phrase)
words.exampleMeaning: I sent a text saying, "May the deceased rest in peace."

words.meaning: chief mourner (the family member who receives guests)
condolence money given to the family
words.exampleMeaning: Always write your name on the condolence money envelope.
I wrote my name in the guest book at the reception desk.

words.meaning: even if (the next part still holds; often used to comfort)
words.exampleMeaning: Even if it takes a while, take your time.

dialogue.meaning: Mark, is this your first time at a funeral hall?

dialogue.korean: 네, 그래서 좀 긴장돼요. 상주한테 뭐라고 말씀드려야 해요?
dialogue.meaning: Yes, so I'm a little nervous. What should I say to the chief mourner?

dialogue.korean: "삼가 고인의 명복을 빕니다."라고 하면 돼요. 말이 잘 안 나오더라도 괜찮아요. 고개를 숙이기만 해도 마음은 전해져요.
dialogue.meaning: You can say, "May the deceased rest in peace." Even if the words don't come out well, it's okay. Just bowing your head shows how you feel.
Where do I give the condolence money?

dialogue.korean: 입구에 있는 접수대에 내면 돼요. 봉투에 이름 쓰는 거 잊지 마세요.
dialogue.meaning: You can give it at the reception desk by the entrance. Don't forget to write your name on the envelope.

dialogue.korean: 팀장님, 삼가 고인의 명복을 빕니다. 얼마나 상심이 크시겠어요.
dialogue.meaning: Team leader, may your father rest in peace. You must be so heartbroken.

dialogue.korean: 바쁠 텐데 이렇게 와 줘서 고마워요.
dialogue.meaning: You must be busy. Thank you for coming.

dialogue.korean: 아니에요. 힘드시더라도 식사는 꼭 챙겨 드세요. 도울 일이 있으면 늦은 시간이더라도 연락 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: Not at all. Even if it's hard, please make sure you eat. If there's anything I can do, call me, even if it's late.

exercises: Change the word in brackets into the -더라도 form: ① (춥다) 날씨가 ____ 발인에는 꼭 갈게요. ② (못 가다) 결혼식에 ____ 축의금은 보낼게요. ③ (멀다) 장례식장이 ____ 가 볼 생각이에요.
Choose what to say (a 삼가 고인의 명복을 빕니다 / b 결혼 축하드려요 / c 아니에요, 당연히 와야지요): ① 친구가 다음 달에 결혼해요. ② 동료의 할머니가 돌아가셨어요. ③ 상주가 "와 줘서 고마워요."라고 해요.
Make one sentence of comfort with -더라도, using 힘들다 and 건강을 챙기다: 팀장님, ____.
Answer in Korean from the dialogue: 마크 씨는 조의금을 어디에 내요?
answers: ① 춥더라도 ② 못 가더라도 ③ 멀더라도
① b ② a ③ c
힘드시더라도 건강 잘 챙기세요. (힘드시더라도 건강 꼭 챙기세요.)
